remarks: STYLISH LUXURY on the Penthouse level of one of Stamford's most elegant high rise buildings, this bright, immaculate, updated 2-BR/2-B flat features panoramic 16th flr cityscape views w/ glorious sunsets. Luxe building amens include 24/7 concierge/security, heated pool, 2-workout centers & library/community rm. Welcome to 16D where you'll enjoy expansive windows, Brazilian walnut wood flrs, chic updates & glassed-in htd Balcony, w/sliders from the LR, that adds space for an office & sunrm. Lg open LR/DR filled w/light is perfect for entertaining & easy living. Updated w/modern flair, the kitchen has granite countertops, abundant cabinetry, stainless appliances, dbl undermounted sink + stunning backsplash. Primary suite BR is large & sunny w/sweeping views & custom outfitted double closet, while the sophisticated marble Primary bath boasts lovely vanity, designer glass tile backsplash & modern lighting mirror to complement the tub w/shower your perfect spot to relax & unwind! Roomy 2nd bedroom w/outfitted closet and stylish luxe marble bathroom w/shower & frameless glass door complete the unit. Special features incl NEW individual cooling/heating units w/bonus of thermostat control in LR/DR - newer Washer/Dryer - backlit LED mirrors in both baths - modern decorator sconces+stunning DR chandelier+recessed Kitchen lights. Assigned garage parking spot & a storage unit, too. You can walk to shops, movies & restaurants, but may never wish to leave this special home!
